title: phpMyAdmin behind .htpasswd: a safe copy-paste recipe
lede: You already protect phpMyAdmin with its own login. A Basic Auth gate in front means bots never touch the PHP. Here is the recipe, and the four ways it locks you out.
hero_alt: Overhead still life: .htaccess printout, .htpasswd card with redacted hash, manila phpMyAdmin tab, four index cards, brass GATE plate.
